name: @scotthuang/agent-knock-knock
changelog: Recognize complete framed multiline Claude Code terminal questionnaires, including custom-text entry, while preserving prompt rows, semantic selection and the original screen fingerprint. Require contiguous framing and a blank option boundary; retain header, footer, cursor, numbering, input-ownership and cross-line secret guards. Unproven shapes and multi-select mutation remain manual; no new Claude native-peer response support or live delivery claim. Coordinated core 0.16.10, Pi 0.1.0-poc.18 and DSH 0.1.0-rc.22. Formal gate passed 3913 core tests, both connector gates, isolated OpenClaw compatibility, runtime validation and package dry-run.
